typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ProductID as integer,
		Name as string,
		ProductNumber as string,
		Color as string,
		StandardCost as decimal(19,4),
		ListPrice as decimal(19,4),
		Size as string,
		Weight as decimal(8,2),
		ProductCategoryID as integer,
		ProductModelID as integer,
		SellStartDate as timestamp,
		SellEndDate as timestamp,
		DiscontinuedDate as timestamp,
		ThumbNailPhoto as binary,
		ThumbnailPhotoFileName as string,
		rowguid as string,
		ModifiedDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table') ~> acweb
acweb sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	deletable:false,
	insertable:true,
	updateable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	format: 'table',
	preSQLs:['ALTER INDEX AKProductName ON SalesLT.Product DISABLE; GO \nALTER INDEX AKProductProductNumber ON SalesLT.Product DISABLE; GO \nALTER INDEX AKProductrowguid ON SalesLT.Product DISABLE; GO\n'],
	postSQLs:['ALTER INDEX AKProductName ON SalesLT.Product ENABLE; GO \nALTER INDEX AKProductProductNumber ON SalesLT.Product ENABLE; GO \nALTER INDEX AKProductrowguid ON SalesLT.Product ENABLE; GO'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	errorHandlingOption: 'stopOnFirstError') ~> acwebarch
